reason: The validator applies profiles (shareablecodesystem and shareablevalueset to every terminology resource; bmi and vitalsigns from meta.profile) whose min is above the base min. D8 keeps only the min of the base resource, which is all the package of the version gives a profile-free projection.

match: ^error\|structure\|[^|]*\|Slice '[^']*': a matching slice is required, but not found \(from http://hl7\.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/(bmi|vitalsigns)\|
reason: A required slice of the vitalsigns and bmi profiles: the profile asks for a category or a value[x] slice that the summary or text projection leaves out; slicing is profile-level and not in the base min.

An invariant over elements the projection dropped (and the resource carries the SUBSETTED tag that says so): the summary of a resource is not required to satisfy the constraints of the elements it leaves out.

match: ^error\|invalid\|StructureDefinition\|The value of Extension\.url is not fixed to the extension URL
reason: A StructureDefinition of an extension projected with true loses its differential and snapshot, which are what fixes Extension.url; the validator then judges the resource as a bare extension definition.

match: ^error\|invalid\|[^|]*\.contained\|The contained resource '[^']*' is not referenced to from elsewhere in the containing resource nor does it refer to the containing resource \(dom-3\)
reason: _elements names contained explicitly: the request is honored whole (D4) even when the element that referred to it was left out.

validator_cli 7.0.2 dies with 'Ambiguous type Extension' while building the OperationOutcome of a StructureDefinition of an extension that has no snapshot or differential (text and _elements modes); the input of the same resource does not crash.

match: ^error\|(code-invalid\|[^|]*\|The value provided \('[^']*'\) was not found in the value set '(Mime Types|Currencies)'|not-found\|[^|]*\|The System URI could not be determined for the code '[^']*' in the ValueSet 'http://hl7\.org/fhir/ValueSet/(mimetypes|currencies)\|)
reason: Without a terminology server (-tx n/a) validator_cli cannot check codes of the mimetypes and currencies value sets, and reports that once per session, on the first file that has them. Verified by hand: ChargeItemDefinition-device.input.json and its data projection give 2 and 0 of these errors when their order in the same session is swapped. The report depends on the batch, not on the resource.

match: ^error\|business-rule\|CodeSystem\|CodeSystem null has an 'all system' value set of
reason: _elements keeps CodeSystem.valueSet but not CodeSystem.url (not named, not min 1); the validator checks the all-system value set against the url of the CodeSystem, which is now absent. The _elements request is honored as asked.

match: ^error\|invalid\|Bundle\|Documents or Messages must contain at least one entry
reason: A Bundle of type document or message projected with text keeps only text, id, meta and the base min>0, so its entry is dropped; the validator requires at least one entry for these types.
